newsitem.title: USA: Heartport to market systems in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Heartport to market systems in Europe.

text.p: Heartport Inc said Monday it had received clearance to market its Port-Access minimally-invasive cardiac surgery systems in all countries of the European Union and the European Free Trade Area.
The company said it will begin commercial sales in Europe in the 1996 first quarter.

Heartport said the clearance covers more than 50 reusable and disposable devices that make up the Port-Access CABG System, used for performing coronary artery bypass grafting procedures, and the Port-Access MVR System, used for performing mitral valve replacement and repair procedures.
Heartport said it received approval for these systems from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration late last year.
Heartport was up 1-1/4 to 29-3/8 in morning trading.
